stage._note: fitmon countTricepsExtensions: wrist above the shoulder with the elbow >160 is the start, <90 counts, 1000 ms. Ceiling 35: Likewise for the elbow at the bottom of an overhead extension. The rep still lands the moment it crosses the counting line; the ceiling only refuses a reading the joint cannot actually produce, which is the only sense a ceiling can have when the rep is over at the crossing.

tempo._note: measured window: topExit crossing -> bottomEnter crossing, not the full descent

cues.enter: Face the camera, both arms straight up overhead, hands together.
cues.tooHigh: Bend the elbows further — lower the hands behind your head.
cues.gate: Keep the elbows up by your ears.
cues.framing: I can't see your elbows — step back.
